props.name: count
props.description: How many streaks. A dozen reads as a shower; forty starts to look like rain.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplies how fast they fall. 2 is twice as fast.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of travel in degrees, clockwise from pointing right. 145 falls down and to the left.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of each tail in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Place the layer inside a positioned container.
